title: farsight-tests-matrix v1
description: The journeys × tests matrix as one flat document: what every test says about every node on every journey, with the evidence class, the run and the identity of the code it was computed from. Prose contract: docs/contracts/farsight-tests-matrix-v1.md. v1 may gain optional fields and new enum members; nothing listed here changes meaning or goes away without a version bump.

metric.description: The `test-coverage` MetricValue for the scope (value · bound · scopeLabel · evidence · gaps). Its shape is owned by core (`metrics.ts`) and carries its own `def.version`; this contract freezes that it is present, not its fields.

def.description: The metric definition, including its `version` — a value stored under an older version is not comparable with this one.

journeys.description: One entry per flow — the same `TestMatrixRow` the catalogue and the HUD read, so the rows below and the journey summaries cannot disagree.

rows.description: One row per (flow, node, test, covers edge), sorted by every column in the order they are declared below.

e2eWord.description: The end-to-end word for a journey: a header-only @covers is `declared`, a test body that reaches something on the journey is `reached`, a run that saw it is `observed`.

identity.description: What the document was computed from. Every row repeats `sync`, `source_commit` and `source_digest`, so a CSV row taken out of the file still says which code it describes.

sync.description: Snapshot ordinal of the graph, when a snapshot store recorded one.

source_commit.description: Workspace commit at snapshot time, when known.

source_digest.description: repo name → content digest of that repo's checkout (parsers/shared/files.ts contentDigest). Empty when the graph records none: absence of a digest is why a run's freshness reads `unknown`.

farsight.description: The build that produced the document (`buildLine()`).

generated_at.description: ISO timestamp. The only field that changes between two runs over the same graph.

screen_id.description: The design id of the screen when this node is one of the flow's screens (the node id when it has none), '' otherwise.

file.description: Repo-relative spec path, or the report path for a run-level node.

suite.description: The describe path, outermost first, joined with ' > '.

project.description: Playwright / Nx project, '' when the runner records none.

run_level.description: true when the edge comes from a coverage report with no per-test attribution: the run reached the node, no single test did.

inactive.description: The case is .skip/.todo (or its edge is marked inactive): it is listed and it lifts no word and no chip.

evidence_class.description: The printed vocabulary. The graph's edge class `static` prints as `reached`; `declared` is an @covers claim; `observed` is a run that executed the node.

technique.description: The covers edge's ResolutionTechnique (see farsight-diff-v1), '' when the edge carries no resolution.

match.description: Observed edges: how the coverage row met the node.

run_at.description: ISO timestamp the report recorded, '' when there is no run.

status.description: `flaky` is its own verdict — the reporter retried and it then passed; it is never `passed`.

stale.description: null when freshness is `unknown` or there is no run: "not stale" and "not proven fresh" are different facts and the matrix never conflates them. CSV prints the null as `unknown`.

source_digest.description: The content digest of the repo this node lives in, from `identity.source_digest`; when the graph records none, the digest the run stamped; '' when neither exists.
